articles.summary: SILVER SPRING, MD / ACCESS Newswire / September 30, 2026 / CuriosityStream Inc. (Nasdaq:CURI), a leading global factual media and entertainment company, today announced the launch of its flagship streaming service, Curiosity Stream, as a subscription on Prime Video in Canada. The launch significantly expands Curiosity Stream's relationship with Prime Video and brings the service's subscription presence to five major English-speaking markets: the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada...
articles.title: Curiosity Stream Launches on Prime Video in Canada
